notes: Pinned results come from the T0356 reference FlagStore. Steps replay in order on one store; seed writes state directly and exists only to reach the revision edge.

happy.name: default_is_sensitive_local_allowed
happy.why: a new collection reads sensitive, local always allowed

happy.name: lower_with_bound_approval_opens_cloud
happy.why: true to false with the bound approval, then cloud is allowed

happy.name: raise_needs_no_approval_and_blocks_next_verdict
happy.why: false to true needs no approval and applies before the next verdict

happy.name: same_value_set_is_a_noop
happy.why: setting the current value keeps the revision

happy.name: rollback_walks_back_one_step_per_call
happy.why: two lowers and raises, then two rollbacks

happy.name: set_after_rollback_continues
happy.why: a set after a rollback continues from the restored value

happy.name: reregister_keeps_state
happy.why: registering again never resets state or revives approvals

boundary.name: commit_just_below_max_reaches_max
boundary.why: a change at 2**63-2 commits to exactly 2**63-1

boundary.name: transition_at_max_is_revision_exhausted
boundary.why: a change at 2**63-1 fails typed, state unchanged

boundary.name: empty_history_rollback_at_max_is_empty_history
boundary.why: empty history is checked before exhaustion

boundary.name: max_revision_is_well_formed_and_stale
boundary.why: 2**63-1 as expected_revision on revision 0 is stale

boundary.name: approval_is_bound_to_the_revision
boundary.why: an approval for revision 0 does not lower at revision 2

boundary.name: approval_is_bound_to_the_collection
boundary.why: an approval for B does not lower A

boundary.name: approval_preimage_known_answer
boundary.why: the sha256 of the literal bytes col1:a..a|0|false

boundary.name: rollback_restoring_false_needs_approval
boundary.why: rolling back to false needs a bound approval

boundary.name: rollback_restoring_true_needs_none
boundary.why: rolling back to true needs no approval

boundary.name: empty_history_after_full_walk_back
boundary.why: the third rollback finds the history empty
